## Stage 2 Findings So Far

So far stage 2 has completely detrailed me from my original idea. At first I wanted to talk about how different states were governing flock cameras but then 
when I started exploring the data I found a connection I did not think of. The majority of flock cameras are put up around Lowe's or The Home Depot which are 
spots that people who are undocumented hang around to try and find work. This prompted me to try and see if there was a connection between the states that had
the most flock cameras and the states that had the highest recoreded immigrant popualtion per population. After some exploration I did find some connection 
but I want to complete more testing and see if the variables are statistically significant. I found that the top five states with the most flock cameras were 
California, Texas, Florida, Georgia, and Illinois. Calinornia has th greatest amount of flock cameras and the highest immigrant share. During the second
poriton I was looking at the entire country to see the distribution of share and cameras. I think in my further studies I will go back to focusing on
California but I do want to know the statistical signifigance of immigrant share and flock camera amount. That will be where I focus my research moving forward. I realized that there was too much information on how different states/counties/cities were using flock and I needed to either narrow my setting down 
or follow another path. For the stage 2 deliverable I will be rewriting my research plan as needed.
